get.summary:
List claims, oldest first by submission (default) or by time in current status. Filter by claimant, assignee,
status, or unassigned claims still waiting to be picked up.

post.summary: An officer picks up an incoming claim (R5).
The assigned officer asks the claimant for more information (R6).
The claimant answers the open information request (R3).
The assigned officer settles the claim (R7).
The assigned officer rejects the claim, giving a reason (R7).
Mark one of your notifications as read.

get.summary: The acting officer's team: open work per officer and decisions in the last 30 days (R8).
Claimed exposure: the claimed amount on claims not yet decided, an upper bound on liability (D7).

ClaimResponse.description: R2: a claim with its history and information requests, so the claimant can track it.

ClaimStatus.description: Lifecycle of a claim. Allowed transitions are documented in docs/design/04-claim-lifecycle.md.

ClaimSummaryResponse.description:
A row in a claim list: the claimant's own claims, or the officer's queue. DateTimeOffset ClaimSummaryResponse.StatusChangedAt is when
the claim entered its current status (latest status history row), so the queue can show what is going stale.

ExposureByAgeResponse.description: Days since submission. Display buckets, not deadlines (ADR-0012).

ExposureResponse.description:
D7: claimed exposure, the sum of `claimed_amount` on claims not yet decided (ADR-0015). An upper bound on
what will be paid, not a reserve. Every status, type and age bucket is listed, with zeros where there is nothing.

MarkNotificationReadRequest.description: A claimant marks one of their notifications as read.

OfficerWorkloadResponse.description:
One officer's open work (workload) and decisions in the period (performance). The average runs from submission to
decision over the decisions in the period, and is null when there are none.

PickUpClaimRequest.description: R5: an officer picks up a claim.

ProvideInformationRequest.description: R3: the claimant answers the open information request.

RejectClaimRequest.description: R7: an officer rejects a claim. The reason is required and is shown to the claimant.

RequestInformationRequest.description: R6: an officer asks the claimant for more information.

SettleClaimRequest.description: R7: an officer settles a claim. The reason is optional.

SystemInfoResponse.description: Basic service information. Placeholder endpoint proving the API → OpenAPI → frontend chain.

UnassignedWorkloadResponse.description: Claims nobody has picked up yet. A team-level figure: they belong to no officer.

WorkloadResponse.description: R8: the acting officer's team, its open work and its decisions in the last int WorkloadResponse.PeriodDays days.
